facts.text: Through the Pioneer Pledge, UW-Platteville guarantees full tuition and fee coverage for new Pell-eligible freshmen on the Platteville campus.

sources.title: Pioneer Pledge | UW-Platteville
sources.quote: Pioneer Pledge guarantees that the cost of undergraduate, on-campus tuition, and fees will be covered for new freshmen attending the Platteville campus who are Pell-eligible.
